Toggle Layer Visibility

Source: R/shiny.R
set_layer_visibility.Rd

Toggle Layer Visibility

Usage

set_layer_visibility(map, id, visible = TRUE)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

id

Layer ID.

visible

Logical (TRUE or FALSE).
